question: Should bundled skill names be intercepted by OpenClaw with local setup guidance, or should ClawHub maintain trusted canonical registry copies of those skills?
rationale: Both approaches can remove the dead end, but they establish different ownership, update, and trust contracts that cannot safely be selected from the current implementation alone.

options.title: Guide bundled setup
options.body: Detect bundled names before registry resolution and explain how to enable the bundled copy and satisfy its dependencies.

options.title: Publish canonical copies
options.body: Create owner-qualified trusted ClawHub records and define how they remain synchronized with OpenClaw's bundled versions.

options.title: Document only
options.body: Keep the current resolver behavior but improve CLI and troubleshooting documentation so users know bundled names are not registry installs.

recommendation.title: Guide bundled setup
recommendation.body: Detect bundled names before registry resolution and explain how to enable the bundled copy and satisfy its dependencies.

likelyOwner.reason: The owner-scoped resolution work explicitly identified the OpenClaw CLI companion behavior and provides the clearest history for deciding the cross-layer contract.
